## Notes

Bossa Studios; made in 48 hours at Global Game Jam 2013, Steam release 2013-04-19; mouse moves hand, A/W/E/R/Space control fingers; patient Bob; heart rate reaching 0 requires defibrillators; iPad 2014, PS4 2014, Switch 2018 with local co-op; controls inspired by Jurassic Park: Trespasser; 2 million sold by 2015.
